title: 大雨事案の未取得判定を自治体のタイル取得状況に合わせる (#324)
purpose: 雨量判定・予測・全国候補抽出に関する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
## 対象
- [案件 #324](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/issues/324) ・ [元の調査](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/issues/287#issuecomment-7226652785) ・ [データ担当への依頼](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/pull/291#issuecomment-7226653168)
- [着手前照合](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/actions/runs/46103749981) は NO_STRONG_MATCH／confirmed／success。

## 実装
- 既存のN03自治体境界と全国スキャンの広域タイルを使い、その自治体に重なる全タイルの最新基準版が揃った時間枠だけ、予報閾値未満と判定できます。古い版や対象タイルの欠けは未取得に留めます。
- 既存の予報ヒットの保存、2版連続の終了条件、答え合わせの手順を維持します。SQLマイグレーションは新旧の記録ジョブに対応し、保存済みデータは更新しません。

## 検証
- ローカル Vitest 71ファイル／450件と回帰 Python 21件・Node 12件が成功。SQL統合テストをCIに追加しました。
- 本番の保存済み時系列と現存する同一基準版の対象タイルを読み取り専用で突き合わせた結果。実行時点のタイル到着順は再現せず、現存するアーカイブを使った比較です。
  - 函館市（04:35 JSTまで）詳細帯 16/56 → 0/56、延長帯 41/59 → 0/59。
  - 氷見市（12:29 JSTまで）詳細帯 15/146 → 0/146、延長帯 123/150 → 0/150。
- 本番DBへのマイグレーション適用や既存記録の補完は別途。

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

  phase1-feedback-rls:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local-test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: phase1_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Test developer dashboard permissions and ground reports
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/rain-dashboard-integration.sql
      - name: Test isolated area shadow schema and permissions
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/rain-shadow-integration.sql
      - name: Test isolated area evidence schema, bytea and permissions
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/rain-area-integration.sql
      - name: Test isolated notification replay schema and private permissions
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/rain-replay-integration.sql
      - name: Test feedback RLS on an isolated Postgres, without changing Push delivery schema
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/feedback-phase1-integration.sql
      - name: Test nationwide forecast snapshot freshness and permissions
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/national-rain-forecast-snapshot-integration.sql
      - name: Test isolated Bluesky staging, deduplication and hourly limit
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/national-bluesky-case-publication-integration.sql
      - name: Test municipal rain case coverage and closure in isolated Postgres
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/national-rain-cases-integration.sql

  phase1-feedback-http:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local-test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: phase1_http
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Initialize disposable feedback RLS fixture
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
        run: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d phase1_http -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/feedback-phase1-http-setup.sql
      - name: Start disposable local PostgREST (no Supabase production traffic)
        env:
          PHASE1_JWT_SECRET: only-for-disposable-ci-not-a-production-jwt-secret
        run: |
          docker run -d --rm --name phase1-postgrest --network host \
            -e PGRST_DB_URI=postgres://postgres:local-test-only@127.0.0.1:5432/phase1_http \
            -e PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS=public \
            -e PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE=anon \
            -e PGRST_JWT_SECRET="$PHASE1_JWT_SECRET" \
            postgrest/postgrest:v12.2.3
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sS --max-time 2 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          docker logs phase1-postgrest
          exit 1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Validate create-edit-reload and owner RLS through HTTP
        env:
          PHASE1_JWT_SECRET: only-for-disposable-ci-not-a-production-jwt-secret
        run: node tests/feedback-phase1-http.mjs
      - name: Remove disposable PostgREST
        if: always()
        run: docker rm -f phase1-postgrest || true

  rain-delivery-concurrency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local-test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: rain_delivery_test
        ports: [5432:5432]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      PGHOST: localhost
      PGUSER: postgres
      PGPASSWORD: local-test-only
      PGDATABASE: rain_delivery_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f tests/sql/rain-delivery-setup.sql
      - run: python tests/rain-delivery-concurrency.py

  edge-deno-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        with:
          deno-version: v2.x
      - name: Type-check the actual watch-rain Edge Function (no DB or Push)
        run: deno check --node-modules-dir=auto supabase/functions/watch-rain/index.ts

name: Nationwide heavy rain forecast

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: national-heavy-rain-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  scan:
    if: github.repository == 'miyazaki1016/emergencyalert' && vars.NATIONAL_HEAVY_RAIN_ACTIONS_ENABLED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'schedule' || vars.RAIN_ACTIONS_TRIGGER_SOURCE != 'cloudflare')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Production
    timeout-minutes: 9
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund tsx@4.20.6
      # These official-N03-derived assets were already shared in the public
      # verification artifacts. Never cache credentials or signed URLs here.
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        id: inputs
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/n03
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lrpm
          key: national-heavy-rain-n03-20260101-lrpm-v1-5fb0823f190e
      - name: Prepare verified N03 and LRPM inputs
        id: prepare
        if: steps.inputs.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: node --import tsx scripts/prepare-national-rain-inputs.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/n03" "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm"
      - name: Scan and publish latest fresh forecast
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
          JMA_Z10_CONCURRENCY: '8'
        run: JMA_Z10_PIXEL_MASK_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm/20260101-v1" node --import tsx scripts/national-heavy-rain-scan.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/n03"
      - name: Record public rain cases from published completed tiles
        if: success() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 1
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: node --import tsx scripts/national-rain-cases.ts ingest "$RUNNER_TEMP/n03"
      - name: Verify ended public rain cases with JMA observations
        if: success() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 1
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: JMA_Z10_PIXEL_MASK_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm/20260101-v1" node --import tsx scripts/verify-national-rain-cases.ts
      - uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        if: always() && steps.inputs.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/n03
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lrpm
          key: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

  bluesky-publication:
    needs: scan
    if: needs.scan.result == 'success' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && vars.BLUESKY_SEND_ENABLED == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Production
    timeout-minutes: 4
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund tsx@4.20.6
      - name: Prepare H.264 encoder
        run: command -v ffmpeg || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg) || true
      - name: Plan and deliver published case alerts
        env:
          BLUESKY_SEND_ENABLED: ${{ vars.BLUESKY_SEND_ENABLED }}
          BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER: ${{ secrets.BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER }}
          BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD }}
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: node --import tsx scripts/bluesky-case-publication.ts --live

new file mode 100644
index 00000000..fd07fdd6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261128040000_national_rain_case_local_coverage.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+-- Prefer municipality coverage when supplied. Legacy callers retain nationwide semantics.
+create or replace function public.ingest_national_rain_case_version(p_base timestamptz, p_batch jsonb)
+returns boolean language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
+declare
+  last_ingested timestamptz;
+  candidate record;
+  incident public.national_rain_cases%rowtype;
+  episode_slots jsonb;
+  episode_state text;
+  version_peak smallint;
+  version_peak_time timestamptz;
+  prior_dry boolean;
+begin
+  if p_base is null or jsonb_typeof(p_batch) is distinct from 'array'
+     or not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_batch) slot where slot->>'band' = 'detail') then
+    raise exception 'invalid case version';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Serialize ingestion so opening/closing and the cursor advance are atomic.
+  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(307, 1);
+  delete from public.national_rain_case_versions v using public.national_rain_cases c
+    where v.slug = c.slug and c.details_expire_at <= now() and not c.permanent;
+  select base_time into last_ingested from public.national_rain_case_cursor where id;
+  if last_ingested >= p_base then return false; end if;
+
+  for candidate in
+    select distinct on (area->>'code') area, (slot->>'validTime')::timestamptz as valid_time
+      from jsonb_array_elements(p_batch) slot
+      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(slot->'municipalities') area
+      where slot->>'band' = 'detail' and (area->>'minimumMmPerHour')::int in (30,50,80)
+        and area->>'basetime' = to_char(p_base at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
+      order by area->>'code', (slot->>'validTime')::timestamptz
+  loop
+    insert into public.national_rain_cases
+      (slug, municipality_code, prefecture, municipality, first_base, first_valid_time,
+       last_base, peak_tier, peak_valid_time)
+    values (
+      (candidate.area->>'code') || '-' || to_char(p_base at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo', 'YYYYMMDD-HH24MI'),
+      candidate.area->>'code', candidate.area->>'prefecture', candidate.area->>'municipality',
+      p_base, candidate.valid_time, p_base, (candidate.area->>'minimumMmPerHour')::smallint, candidate.valid_time)
+    on conflict do nothing;
+  end loop;
+
+  for incident in select * from public.national_rain_cases where status = 'forecast'
+  loop
+    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+      'validTime', slot->>'validTime', 'band', slot->>'band',
+      'state', case when hit.area is not null then 'rain'
+                    when case
+                      when slot ? 'completeMunicipalities' then
+                        jsonb_typeof(slot->'completeMunicipalities') = 'array'
+                        and (slot->'completeMunicipalities') ? incident.municipality_code
+                      else slot->>'complete' = 'true'
+                    end then 'below' else 'unknown' end,
+      'tier', (hit.area->>'minimumMmPerHour')::smallint, 'basetime', hit.area->>'basetime',
+      'radarTile', hit.area->'radarTile', 'tileCoverage', slot->'tileCoverage'
+    ) order by slot->>'validTime') into episode_slots
+    from jsonb_array_elements(p_batch) slot
+    left join lateral (
+      select area from jsonb_array_elements(slot->'municipalities') area
+        where area->>'code' = incident.municipality_code
+        order by (area->>'minimumMmPerHour')::smallint desc limit 1
+    ) hit on true;
+
+    select case when bool_or(slot->>'state' = 'rain') then 'rain'
+                when bool_and(slot->>'state' = 'below') then 'below' else 'unknown' end
+      into episode_state from jsonb_array_elements(episode_slots) slot where slot->>'band' = 'detail';
+
+    select (slot->>'tier')::smallint, (slot->>'validTime')::timestamptz into version_peak, version_peak_time
+      from jsonb_array_elements(episode_slots) slot where slot->>'tier' is not null
+      order by (slot->>'tier')::smallint desc, (slot->>'validTime')::timestamptz limit 1;
+
+    select exists (select 1 from public.national_rain_case_versions
+      where slug = incident.slug and base_time = p_base - interval '5 minutes' and detail_state = 'below')
+      into prior_dry;
+    insert into public.national_rain_case_versions (slug, base_time, detail_state, peak_tier, peak_valid_time, slots)
+      values (incident.slug, p_base, episode_state, version_peak, version_peak_time, episode_slots);
+    update public.national_rain_cases set
+      last_base = p_base,
+      peak_tier = greatest(incident.peak_tier, version_peak),
+      peak_valid_time = case when version_peak > incident.peak_tier then version_peak_time
+                        when version_peak = incident.peak_tier then least(incident.peak_valid_time, version_peak_time)
+                        else incident.peak_valid_time end,
+      status = case when episode_state = 'below' and prior_dry then 'ended' else 'forecast' end,
+      ended_at = case when episode_state = 'below' and prior_dry then p_base end,
+      details_expire_at = case when episode_state = 'below' and prior_dry
+        and greatest(incident.peak_tier, version_peak) = 30 then p_base + interval '7 days' end
+      where slug = incident.slug;
+  end loop;
+
+  insert into public.national_rain_case_cursor (id, base_time) values (true, p_base)
+    on conflict (id) do update set base_time = excluded.base_time;
+  return true;
+end;
+$$;

import concurrent.futures, subprocess
T='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';S='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222'
def sql(q):
 return subprocess.check_output(['psql','-q','-X','-A','-t','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c','set role service_role; '+q],text=True).strip()
def race(q):
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as ex:return list(ex.map(sql,[q,q]))
leases=race(f"select coalesce(public.claim_rain_watch_target('{T}')::text,'BUSY')")
assert leases.count('BUSY')==1,leases
lease=next(x for x in leases if x!='BUSY')
claims=race(f"select coalesce(public.claim_rain_push_attempt('{T}','{lease}','episode/APPROACH','{S}')::text,'SKIP')")
assert claims.count('SKIP')==1,claims
attempt=next(x for x in claims if x!='SKIP')
assert sql('select count(*) from rain_push_attempts')=='1'
# Transport accepted, history/state update could fail. A new lease cannot resend.
sql(f"select public.finish_rain_push_attempt('{attempt}','ACCEPTED')")
sql(f"update rain_watch_runtime set leased_until=now()-interval '1 second'")
